description: Follow a run step by step. Returns the steps after index `after` (start with -1, then pass the lastIndex you got) and the comments. Joining late, you get the newest `last` steps and `skipped` says how many came before (get_trajectory has them all). `progress` says how the checks are going, `request` what the agent was last asked, `quiet_seconds` how long since its last step. If the run is live and nothing is new, waits up to `wait_seconds` for the next step. Pass comments_after (the lastComment you got) to get only new comments. include_screenshot adds the latest screen as an image.

comments_after.description: Only comments after this one: the lastComment you got. -1 gives the latest 20

id.description: Run id, from live_streams or search_runs

last.description: At most this many of the newest steps (long outputs and diffs are cut short)

my_name.description: Your name, shown to the broadcaster as a viewer
